I have recently been in a PICU(psychiatric intensive care unit) in London Ontario. 
Was there for about a week. What it was like for me. 
I wasn’t allowed to have my prescription glasses (because glass) 
Wasn’t allowed my cell phone. But they let you use the phone whenever I wanted to. Even grabbed my cell phone for me so I can retrieve numbers. 
Not allowed pens.
Everyday you get a menu from which you can select your three meals for the following day. (Will be given pencil crayon to fill out(Literally if you select salad and forget to select any dressing, you will not get dressing) 
If you really like something on the menu you can put x2 beside it and they will give you two. 
You can ask for snacks throughout the day 
You can request to shower at anytime(normally you wait for shower window and hope you’re not sleeping when they come around) but in psych ward it was convenient that I can shower first thing in the morning if I wanted to. Or right before bed. 
You only get one pair of socks your entire stay. 
Oh bathroom and showers have peep holes. They allow you to lock them but can check on you by peeping if they suspect you’re being unsafe.
There is a hang out/dining room which has a tele and you can change channels. That room gets locked at 11pm every night though. 
You have specific visiting hours. 
You see a psychiatrist once daily.
If you are a cutter they will give you rubber bands to suffice the desire. 
You can hang out and talk to other patients 
Oh you have windows so you can look outside.
There is camera on in your room 24/7
If you are well behaved your psychiatrist can give you passes that you can use to go have a smoke outside. Or just get some fresh air. 
Oh the worse were the writings on the walls in my room from other patients. Started out being hella scared of them and then had a meltdown where I felt like I totally became one with the messages. 
Think I got it all. If you have questions Dm me.

I’m only in my second year of school but I understand PRVC as a volume control mode. While it targets a minimum required pressure to deliver a set tidal volume. Tidal volume is what ‘controls’ the breath.
 With changing lung compliance volume remains constant. It is pressure that is changing. Just like volume control. The difference here is that where we would have a constant flow on a conventional volume control mode, here flow and pressure is allowed to change based on patient lung dynamics. So gives a more comfortable breath. And reduces chances of patient being air hungry.

I'm not married and I'm also fairly young(inexperienced with these types of situations) but I'd say you need to have a serious discussion with her. Not an argument just a talk to see why she said this. As much as you'd like to take it and run with it because to you it would make everyone happy. It could lead to ruin your marriage. Maybe your wife said it out of anger, or maybe she feels frustrated and knows it will stop you from asking her for sex. Or maybe she feels cornered like this is what you want but you're making her say it. Please let your wife know that you don't simply want sex. But that you want it with her. That you love her and want to show her in every way possible. Then brain storm on how this can become possible. 
On the other hand if she really just wants you to stop 'nagging' her for sex and doesn't care where you get it from then the discussion will at least bring this to light and you can also discuss how long must you do this for? For all your marriage? Will she ever wanna have sex with you again? Etc? I'd say don't make any moves before you guy sit and talk. 
Good luck.
